$comment: Litematica's own schematic format versions, with where each number came from.
Generated and maintained by the `mc-litematic` skill (.claude/skills/mc-litematic).
`node scripts/gen-litematica-versions.mjs` turns this into the table in
src/shared/litematica_versions.ts; editing that table by hand is fine right up until
The `Version` tag decides how Litematica reads the file, and reading it wrong is silent:
a file whose Version is below 5, or whose MinecraftDataVersion is below 1631, is run
through convertBlockStatePalette_1_12_to_1_13_2 -- so a modern palette under an old
label comes back converted, not refused. That is why these numbers are looked up and
`since` is the oldest Minecraft release whose Litematica writes this Version, and
`sinceDataVersion` is that release's DataVersion, which is what this app actually
compares against -- the document carries a DataVersion, not a release name.

sources.litematica: https://github.com/maruohon/litematica -- SCHEMATIC_VERSION and SCHEMATIC_VERSION_SUB in src/main/java/fi/dy/masa/litematica/schematic/LitematicaSchematic.java, read per branch
sources.litematica-fork: https://github.com/sakura-ryoko/litematica -- the same file on the modern branch, where development continues
sources.litemapy: https://github.com/SmylerMC/litemapy -- LITEMATIC_VERSION, LITEMATIC_SUBVERSION and MC_DATA_VERSION in litemapy/info.py
